title: Beyond Greenwashing: Algorithmic Resilience and the Non-Linear Governance Premium in Sovereign Capital Flows
abstract: arXiv:2610.35895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite the proliferation of sovereign Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) metrics, traditional linear macro-financial models systematically misprice Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) tail risks during systemic shocks. This paper demonstrates that sovereign risk transmission is fundamentally non-linear. Using a forward-chained global panel of 147 sovereign entities (2010-2024), we deploy a gradient boosting architecture that compresses forecast errors by over 39% against L1-regularized baselines precisely during extreme macroeconomic tail events. Moving beyond opaque predictive accuracy, we apply dual interpretability frameworks to mathematically map the discrete threshold effects of institutional quality. We identify a strict, non-linear "Governance Premium": incremental environmental and social improvements yield zero capital advantage until a foundational regulatory threshold is breached. Finally, we establish regime-condition

translated_title: 超越漂绿：主权资本流动中的算法韧性与非线性治理溢价
translated_abstract: 尽管主权环境、社会和治理（ESG）指标日益普及，传统的线性宏观金融模型在系统性冲击期间仍会系统性地错误定价外国直接投资（FDI）的尾部风险。本文证明主权风险传导在本质上是非线性的。基于2010年至2024年147个主权实体的前向滚动全球面板数据，我们部署了一种梯度提升架构，在经济极端尾部事件期间，相比L1正则化基线模型，将预测误差压缩了超过39%。超越单纯追求不透明的预测准确性，我们应用双重可解释性框架，从数学上刻画了制度质量的离散阈值效应。我们识别出一个严格的非线性“治理溢价”：在基础性监管阈值被突破之前，环境和社会层面的渐进式改善不会带来任何资本优势。
tldr: 本文利用梯度提升模型与双重可解释性框架，揭示主权风险传导本质上是非线性的，并提出“治理溢价”概念——ESG改善只有在突破关键治理阈值后才能为国家级资本流入带来优势。
en_tdlr: This paper uses a gradient boosting architecture and dual interpretability frameworks to show that sovereign risk transmission is fundamentally non-linear, establishing a strict "Governance Premium" whereby ESG improvements yield zero capital-flow advantage until a foundational regulatory threshold is breached.
